summary: Iteration 3 tested new features: verify_url on certs, drag-and-drop reorder, cert lightbox, terminal-style 404. Backend: 5/6 new tests pass. Frontend: all new UI features work. One backend bug found: PUT /api/certifications/{id} with verify_url='' does NOT clear the field to null (FastAPI Optional[str]=Form(None) treats empty string as None, so the 'if verify_url is not None' branch is skipped and update never executes).

minor.issue: Sending verify_url='' does not clear stored verify_url to null; the field remains unchanged. Root cause: Optional[str]=Form(None) coerces empty string to None, so `if verify_url is not None` is False. Fix: use a sentinel default (e.g., Form('__NOCHANGE__')) or a Form(...) with a separate 'clear' flag, or check `verify_url == ''` explicitly. Current frontend edit form sends '' when user clears field, so users cannot remove a verify URL once set.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby/Description prop -> console warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Minor a11y issue only.

action_items: Backend: Fix PUT /api/certifications/{id} to actually clear verify_url when empty string is sent. Suggested fix: replace `if verify_url is not None:` with two Form fields (use sentinel) OR receive as `verify_url: str = Form('')` and always apply it. Alternatively, on the frontend, send a whitespace/sentinel value to clear.
Frontend (optional): add DialogDescription (visually hidden) inside cert-lightbox DialogContent to remove the a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_certification: Optional[str]=Form(None) plus `if verify_url is not None` cannot distinguish 'not sent' from 'sent as empty'; FastAPI collapses empty form values to None here, breaking clear-to-null semantics.
Certifications.jsx DialogContent missing accessible description (Radix warning).
CertManager.jsx onDrop mutates local state optimistically then re-loads via API; correct pattern.
server.py CORS uses allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' fallback when CORS_ORIGINS env is unset — could be an issue in prod; acceptable here since CORS_ORIGINS should be explicit.
seed_data_creation: None. Test creates and deletes its own TEST_ certs.

All new features (verify_url in create form, drag-and-drop reorder, lightbox dialog, 404 page) work correctly on the frontend. Only backend bug is the empty-string clearing of verify_url on PUT.

rca of the issue.bug: PUT /api/certifications/{id} with form field verify_url='' does not clear the stored value.
rca of the issue.reproduce: 1) POST /api/certifications with verify_url=https://foo.com. 2) PUT /api/certifications/{id} with form field verify_url='' (empty). 3) Response and DB still contain verify_url='https://foo.com' instead of null.
rca of the issue.root_cause: In FastAPI, `verify_url: Optional[str] = Form(None)` receives an empty string form value as None, so the guard `if verify_url is not None` is False and the update dict is never populated with verify_url.
rca of the issue.mitigation: Either (a) receive as `verify_url: Optional[str] = Form('__KEEP__')` sentinel and treat empty string as clear; or (b) always accept string default '' and apply update['verify_url'] = verify_url.strip() or None unconditionally; or (c) accept a separate boolean form field 'clear_verify_url'.
